title: Tapwater-contaminant mixtures and risk in a biofuel-facility impacted private-well community
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00490J, Paper

Paul M. Bradley, Shannon M. Meppelink, Kristin M. Romanok, Molly L. Schreiner, Kelly L. Smalling, Shannon L. Bartelt-Hunt, Brenda K. Densmore, Stephanie E. Gordon, Keith A. Loftin, Richard Blaine McCleskey, Eleanor G. Rogan, David L. Rus, Daniel D. Snow
We assessed private-well drinking water (DW) at the point of use (i.e., tapwater, TW) within a rural Nebraska community around a state-closed biofuel facility, which used pesticide-treated corn seed as feedstock for ethanol production.
